# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting E6 Code privately through a
[GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/emikael/e6code/security/advisories/new). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://e6code.com/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
